build_dataset_from_txt_files: build a dataset for LLM completion from text files in a directory with train and validation splits
get_max_token_length: get the maximum token length across all examples in a dataset using a given tokenizer
clip_and_filter_datasets: clip and filter datasets to remove examples exceeding the maximum allowed token length
build_dataset_with_custom_splits: build a dataset with custom train and validation file paths and optional size limits
summarize_dataset_token_lengths: summarize the token length distribution across train and validation dataset splits
